rationale: Injected ethanolic tarragon extract reduced mouse forced-swim immobility and tail suspension at one dose. This does not test oral dried leaves or patient depressive symptoms.
Oral shoot extract in feed changed selected mouse social-defeat outcomes. Sucrose preference was inconclusive (p=.565). No clinical depressive symptom or ordinary dried-leaf exposure.
Artemisia genus review cites the oral extract stress model and discusses other species. It supplies no independent human depression study for culinary tarragon.
Author abstract addresses time and melancholia in psychoanalytic practice. It gives no tarragon or food intervention or comparative patient outcome.
